text: Q: How long does a failed UPI refund take? A: Failed UPI transactions are automatically reversed within 3 to 5 business days to your linked bank account.
Q: What is the daily UPI transfer limit on NovaPay? A: Standard users can send up to ₹1,00,000 per day across a maximum of 20 UPI transactions.
Q: How do I complete full KYC verification? A: Open Profile > KYC Verification, upload your PAN card and Aadhaar, and complete a 30-second live video selfie.
Q: What is the minimum balance required for a NovaPay wallet? A: NovaPay digital wallets have zero minimum balance requirements and no annual maintenance fees.
Q: How do I block a lost or stolen physical debit card? A: Go to Cards > Freeze Card immediately in the app, or call our 24/7 toll-free helpline.
Q: Are international transactions enabled by default? A: No, international e-commerce and POS payments are disabled by default per RBI guidelines and can be toggled in Card Settings.
Q: How can I download my annual interest and TDS certificate? A: Navigate to Statements > Tax Reports, select the financial year, and download the signed PDF.
Q: What happens if I miss my credit line EMI due date? A: A late payment fee of ₹250 plus 2% monthly interest applies after a 3-day grace period.
Q: How do I change my registered mobile number? A: Visit Account Settings > Security > Update Mobile Number and verify via OTP on both old and new SIMs.
Q: Can I add a nominee to my NovaPay savings account? A: Yes, go to Profile > Nominee Details and submit the nominee's full name, date of birth, and relationship.
Q: How do I reset my 4-digit app login PIN? A: Tap 'Forgot PIN' on the login screen and authenticate using your registered mobile OTP and debit card last 4 digits.
Q: What are the NEFT and IMPS transfer charges? A: IMPS and NEFT transfers initiated through the NovaPay mobile app are completely free of charge.
Q: How do I close my NovaPay account permanently? A: Ensure your wallet balance is zero, clear any pending dues, and submit an account closure request under Help > Close Account.
Q: Why is my wallet cashback still showing as pending? A: Merchant cashback credits within 7 working days after the return window of your order closes.
Q: How do I enable biometric fingerprint login? A: Open Settings > App Lock and toggle on Biometric Authentication.
Q: What should I do if I receive a suspicious phishing SMS? A: Never click unknown links or share OTPs. Forward the SMS to 1909 and report it in the app under Security.
Q: How do I increase my contactless tap-and-pay limit? A: You can adjust your contactless NFC limit up to ₹5,000 per tap inside Card Controls.
Q: Where can I find my virtual UPI ID (VPA)? A: Your primary VPA (e.g., yourname@novapay) is displayed at the top of the home screen under your QR code.
Q: How do I dispute an unauthorized card transaction? A: Tap the transaction in your history, select 'Report Unauthorized Charge', and freeze your card immediately.
